title: Knowledge Base
switchDesc: Collect project documents (md/word/pdf and other text files) into a local knowledge base organized by folders and tags. When enabled, new sessions get kb_* retrieval and organizing tools plus the companion skill, and the AI can search and reorganize your knowledge base on request. Zero injection when the library is empty.
onHint: New sessions will include knowledge base retrieval/organizing tools and the companion skill
offHint: Sessions no longer get knowledge base tools, and the companion skill is removed (running sessions unaffected)
noteRedline: The knowledge base uses plugin-private storage (~/.zcgui/knowledge/) and never touches session data
locationDesc: The whole knowledge base (folders, tags, snapshots, version history) lives in ~/.zcgui/knowledge by default and can move to another local disk. The entry path stays the same, so existing sessions and AI tools are unaffected. Network paths are not supported.
syncDesc: The knowledge base is a Git repository. After configuring a private remote, click Sync on the tool window toolbar to push; on another computer, enter the same URL, save, and click Sync to fetch it. Syncing pushes document full text (with history) — do not collect documents containing passwords or keys.
reindexDesc: Clears the search cache and re-extracts from current content (entries whose source is gone are rebuilt from snapshots); for repairing corrupted caches or parse errors, not needed in daily use
